replication_status: exact (authors' code reproduces the shipped log, whose 6 post bins equal printed Table 6 column (4) q+1..q+6 = 0.048, -0.118, -0.182, -0.122, -0.128, -0.311 (t = 0.184, -0.334, -0.402, -0.235, -0.228, -0.490) to the printed decimals; published_coef -0.1355 is their equal-weight average (log average -0.13537598333333334); N 3,662; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
replication_vs_log: exact (fixest = authors' reghdfe keepsing log to all printed digits; N and clusters match)
notes: Sustainalytics ESG score. Authors' code (4. table 3 4/Tables 3 and 4.do, line 47): reghdfe sust_esgscore_alt t_plus1 ... t_plus6 if j>-8 & j<6, a(wficn1 yearqtr) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. Sample: fund-quarter panel, opentonewinv==1 and row-count event quarter j in -7..5 (j counts panel rows from the first post-signing row, so it differs from calendar distance when a fund's panel has gaps). Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef -0.135376 vs -0.135376, N 3662 vs 3662, clusters 478 vs 478. Regression sample: N = 3662, 478 funds, 35 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 34, of which 30 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 34 of the 35 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 248 (32.1% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 20. Event study: the authors' dynamic columns use post-only bins t_plus1..t_plus6 (= row-count j = 0..5) with all pre-signing rows pooled as the reference. run_spec.R with event_pre_min = 0 and event_post_max = 5 reproduces this structure (pre rows -> reference -1) but bins by CALENDAR relative time; 114 treated rows fall in a different bin and 65 rows with calendar relative time > 5 go to the separate endpoint bin (excluded from the post average). Authors' post average (equal weight over the 6 bins) = -0.135376; calendar-bin TWFE post average on the same sample = -0.0484536 (raw units). A fully dynamic specification with leads is not used because, without never-treated funds, unit FE + period FE + all relative-time dummies are collinear. Table/column labels are inferred from package folder names and code order (no article text). run_spec.R also maps funds that signed before the first sample period to period 1, which shifts their relative-time bins (TVL spec: 35 funds, 113 rows).

event_structure.source: 4. table 3 4/Tables 3 and 4.do line 47: reghdfe sust_esgscore_alt t_plus1-t_plus6 if j>-8 & j<6, a(wficn1 yearqtr) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. t_plusk = 1[j == k-1] (verified), where j is the authors' ROW-COUNT event quarter (1. building data/3_2.x-section.sas lines 316-350: j = 0 at the fund's first post-signing row, +-1 per panel row); all pre-signing rows (j = -7..-1) are the pooled reference and the j window is the sample filter. Pipeline rel = q - gpost (gpost = q at j == 0 for every fund; true pre-sample signing quarters are in gvar). rel = j except after a gap in the fund's quarterly panel (then rel > j). The last bin is open ([5,null]) so that treated rows with j <= 5 but rel > 5 stay in a post bin and the authors' N is kept.
event_structure.verified: TWFE with these bins on j (event_time_authors_var) reproduces the 6 logged coefficients, max abs diff 4.3e-08, N 3662. Calendar bins (rel = t - g, true gpost; used by CSA cells) differ: 80 of 2345 treated rows fall in a different bin; TWFE with calendar bins would give max abs coefficient diff 7.0e-02 and post average -0.107735 vs logged -0.135376 (raw units).

event_time_authors_note: Lead decision (Nov 2): TWFE indicators and the imputation estimator's observation-level bin averages use the bins and ref of event_structure on the authors' row-count event quarter j (column j of the data file; no NA in the sample); DiD-averaging (CSA) cells are calendar (g,t) cells and use rel = t - g with the same bin boundaries. uncovered = ref (no drop).
presample_adopters_nov2: 30 funds (88 rows) signed before the first sample period; their true signing period is in gvar, so no adoption_var is needed.
